name: Parcel Van
summary: A Place order button that opens into a street scene where a van picks up your parcel
about: An order summary with a Place order button that squashes, then grows into a tiny street with drifting clouds and a glowing sun. A van drives in and brakes, its door swings open, the parcel hops aboard while a loading pill fills, and the van drives off with dust and speed lines. The button settles on a green confirmation with a ripple, confetti and a tracking number.
how: Check the order summary and press Place order
The button squashes, then grows tall and shows a street with a parcel waiting
A van drives in and brakes with a little wobble
The door swings open, the parcel hops in and a loading pill fills
The van drives off with dust while the town slides by
The button shrinks to a green confirmation with confetti and a tracking number
After a few seconds the button resets
